entries.source: A mysterious staff
entries.target: 神秘的法杖

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the ruins of Kor'Pul and vanquished the Possessed.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你探索了卡·普尔废墟并击败了幽灵附体的强盗头目。#WHITE#

entries.source: Remember, the floating islands are not stable and might teleport randomly. However, the disturbances also help you: your Phase Door spell is fully controllable even if not of high level yet.
entries.target: 记住，浮岛并不稳定，可能会随机传送。不过这种扰动也对你有利：即使你的相位之门法术等级还不高，也能完全控制传送位置。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored Norgos' Lair and stopped the shivgoroth invasion.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了诺尔格斯的巢穴并阻止了西弗格罗斯的入侵。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored Norgos' Lair and put it to rest.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了诺尔格斯的巢穴，并让诺尔格斯安息了。#WHITE#

entries.source: Following The Way
entries.target: 追随维网

entries.source: You have been tasked to remove at least one of the threats to the yeeks.
entries.target: 你被派去至少清除一个对夺心魔的威胁。

entries.source: Protect the Way, and vanquish your foes.
entries.target: 守护维网，征服你的敌人。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the underwater zone and vanquished the naga invader, Lady Nashva.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了水下区域并击败了娜迦侵略者纳纱瓦女士。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the underwater zone and vanquished Murgol.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了水下区域并击败了穆格尔。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the underwater lair of Murgol.#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须调查一下穆格尔位于水下的巢穴。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the ritch tunnels and vanquished their queen.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你调查了里奇通道并击败了它们的虫母。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the ritch tunnels.#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须调查一下里奇通道。#WHITE#

entries.source: You should head to the tunnel to Maj'Eyal and explore the world. For the Way.
entries.target: 你应该通过通道到达马基·埃亚尔，探索这个世界。为了维网。

entries.source: Into the darkness
entries.target: 进入黑暗

entries.source: It is time to explore some new places -- dark, forgotten and dangerous ones.
entries.target: 是时候去一些新的地方探索一下了——那些黑暗、被遗忘和危险的地方。

entries.source: The Old Forest is just south-east of the town of Derth.
entries.target: 在德斯镇东南方向是古老森林。

entries.source: The Maze is west of Derth.
entries.target: 在德斯镇西面是迷宫。

entries.source: The Sandworm Lair is to the far west of Derth, near the sea.
entries.target: 在德斯镇遥远的西面，靠近海岸的地方是沙虫巢穴。

entries.source: The Daikara is on the eastern borders of the Thaloren forest.
entries.target: 岱卡拉位于自然精灵树林的东部边境。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Old Forest and vanquished Shardskin.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了古老森林并杀死了水晶树精。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Old Forest and vanquished Wrathroot.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了古老森林并杀死了狂怒树精。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the Old Forest and find out what lurks there and what treasures are to be gained!#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你应当探索古老森林，查清那里潜伏的危险，并获得那里的宝藏！#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Maze and vanquished the Horned Horror.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了迷宫并杀死了长角恐魔。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Maze and vanquished the Minotaur.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了迷宫并杀死了米诺陶。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the Maze and find out what lurks there and what treasures are to be gained!#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你应当探索迷宫，查清那里潜伏的危险，并获得那里的宝藏！#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Sandworm Lair and vanquished their Queen.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了沙虫巢穴并杀死了沙虫女王。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the Sandworm Lair and find out what lurks there and what treasures are to be gained!#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你必须探索沙虫巢穴，查明那里潜伏着什么，以及能获得什么宝藏！#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Daikara and vanquished the huge fire dragon that dwelled there.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了岱卡拉并杀死了盘踞在那里的巨型火龙。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Daikara and vanquished the huge ice dragon that dwelled there.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了岱卡拉并杀死了这里的冰龙。#WHITE#

entries.source: #SLATE#* You must explore the Daikara and find out what lurks there and what treasures are to be gained!#WHITE#
entries.target: #SLATE#* 你应当探索岱卡拉，查清那里潜伏的危险，并获得那里的宝藏！#WHITE#

entries.source: Strange new world
entries.target: 陌生的新世界

entries.source: You arrived through the farportal in a cave, probably in the Far East.
entries.target: 你经由远行传送门抵达了一处山洞，大概位于远东大陆。

entries.source: Upon arrival you met an Elf and an orc fighting.
entries.target: 抵达时，你碰到一个精灵正在和一个兽人战斗。

entries.source: You decided to side with the Elven lady.
entries.target: 你决定帮助那位精灵女士。

entries.source: You decided to side with the orc.
entries.target: 你决定帮助那个兽人。

entries.source: Fillarel told you to go to the southeast and meet with High Sun Paladin Aeryn.
entries.target: 菲拉瑞尔告诉你去东南方会见高阶太阳骑士艾琳。

entries.source: Krogar told you to go to the west and look for the Kruk Pride.
entries.target: 克洛加尔告诉你去西面寻找克鲁克部落。

entries.source: %s go to the west, and find Kruk Pride!
entries.target: %s，去西边，寻找克鲁克部落！

entries.source: %s go to the southeast, and tell Aeryn what happened to me!
entries.target: %s，去东南方，告诉艾琳我的遭遇！

entries.source: The Temple of Creation
entries.target: 造物者神庙

entries.source: Ukllmswwik asked you to take his portal to the Temple of Creation and kill Slasul who has turned mad.
entries.target: 乌克勒姆斯维奇请求你穿过他的传送门到造物者神庙去杀死发疯了的萨拉苏尔。

entries.source: Slasul told you his side of the story. Now you must decide: which of them is corrupt?
entries.target: 萨拉苏尔向你讲述了他这一方的说法，你现在必须决定：到底谁才是真正的堕落者？

entries.source: Slasul bound his lifeforce to yours and gave your a powerful trident in return.
entries.target: 萨拉苏尔将自己的生命力与你的生命力绑定，并以一把强大的三叉戟作为回报。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have killed both Ukllmswwik and Slasul, betraying them both.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你把乌克勒姆斯维奇和萨拉苏尔都杀掉了，同时背叛了他们两个。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have sided with Ukllmswwik and killed Slasul.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你选择相信乌克勒姆斯维奇并杀死了萨拉苏尔。#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have sided with Slasul and killed Ukllmswwik.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你选择相信萨拉苏尔并杀死了乌克勒姆斯维奇。#WHITE#

entries.source: Portal to the Temple of Creation
entries.target: 通向造物者神庙的传送门

entries.source: A portal opens behind Ukllmswwik.
entries.target: 乌克勒姆斯维奇身后开启了一道传送门。

entries.source: Portal to the Flooded Cave
entries.target: 通向淹没的洞穴的传送门

entries.source: A portal opens to the flooded cave.
entries.target: 一道通往被淹没洞穴的传送门开启了。

entries.source: Back and Back and Back to the Future
entries.target: 回到、回到、回到未来

entries.source: After passing through some kind of time anomaly you met a temporal warden who told you to destroy the abominations of this alternate timeline.
entries.target: 穿过某种时间异常后，你碰到了一个时空守卫，他告诉你去摧毁这个变换时间线里的怪物。

entries.source: Temporal Warden
entries.target: 时空守卫

entries.source: Hidden treasure
entries.target: 隐藏的财宝

entries.source: You have found all the clues leading to the hidden treasure. There should be a way on the third level of the Trollmire.
entries.target: 你已经找到了所有有关秘密财宝的线索，在巨魔沼泽第三层应该能找到一条通往那里的路。

entries.source: It looks extremely dangerous, however - beware.
entries.target: 注意：看样子那里非常危险。

entries.source: You have slain Bill. His treasure is yours for the taking.
entries.target: 你已经干掉了比尔，他的财宝现在归你了。

entries.source: way to the hidden trollmire treasure
entries.target: 通往巨魔沼泽隐藏宝藏的路

entries.source: Beware!
entries.target: 小心！

entries.source: Danger...
entries.target: 小心……

entries.source: This way leads to the lair of a mighty troll. Traces of blood are everywhere. Are you sure?
entries.target: 这条路通往巨魔的巢穴，一路上到处都是血迹，你确定要进去么？

entries.source: The way to the treasure is to the east. But beware, death probably awaits there.
entries.target: 通向宝藏的路在东边。但是请当心，死亡很可能就在那里等着你。

entries.source: Tutorial: combat stats
entries.target: 教程：战斗属性

entries.source: Explore the Dungeon of Adventurer Enlightenment to learn about ToME's combat mechanics.
entries.target: 探索冒险者启蒙地下城，学习 ToME 的战斗机制。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#You have navigated the Dungeon of Adventurer Enlightenment!#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#你已经通过冒险者启蒙地下城！#WHITE#

entries.source: Tutorial Finished
entries.target: 教程已完成

entries.source: Tutorial
entries.target: 教程

entries.source: You must venture in the heart of the forest and kill the Lone Wolf, who randomly attacks villagers.
entries.target: 你必须深入森林的中心地带，杀死那头会随机袭击村民的孤狼。

entries.source: Tutorial: Movement
entries.target: 教程：移动

entries.source: In the void, no one can hear you scream
entries.target: 虚空之中无人会听到你的叫喊

entries.source: You have destroyed the sorcerers. Sadly, the portal to the Void remains open; the Creator is coming.
entries.target: 你已经消灭了那些巫师。遗憾的是，通往虚空的传送门仍然敞开；造物主即将降临。

entries.source: This cannot be allowed to happen. After thousands of years trapped in the Void between the stars, Gerlyk is mad with rage.
entries.target: 绝不能让这种事发生。盖里克被困在群星之间的虚空中数千年，如今已因愤怒而疯狂。

entries.source: You must now finish what the Sher'tuls started. Take the Staff of Absorption and become a Godslayer yourself.
entries.target: 现在，你必须完成夏·图尔开启的未竟之事。拿起吸能法杖，亲自成为弑神者。
